approvals.reason: Initial 0.8 baselines for the gate-blocking Extend-parity surfaces: button, select, dialog, tooltip, file-upload, file-thumbnail, pdf-toolbar, pdf-sidebar at 1440x900 and 390x844, light and dark.

First baselines for the #158 shared chrome evidence: the generic DocumentViewerSidebar (inline open/closed/skeleton + overlay open/closed) and the upstream-aligned empty/error/loading/status-bar surfaces are pixel-equal to the pinned Extend reference; 48 files at 1440x900 and 390x844, light and dark.
